name: manual_b2efa4
claim: Resolve a bare agent command on PATH only: require the hit to live in a listed PATH directory, distrust empty entries, strip quotes from entries before lookup, and fall back to the default search path when PATH is unset; Windows which() prefers the working directory.

decisions.notes: 2026-10-19: orama-system dispatcher preflight; mutation of the guard fails the tests and the quoted-PATH end-to-end test failed without the cleaned lookup.

rationale: 2026-10-19: orama-system dispatcher preflight; mutation of the guard fails the tests and the quoted-PATH end-to-end test failed without the cleaned lookup.
